raisedIn: Park Slope, Brooklyn, New York City
background: Born and raised in Park Slope, Brooklyn, in a Reform interfaith home where two grandmothers from different parts of the country shared one kitchen.
regionalHistory: Her parents brought small-town synagogue potlucks and church-choir harmonies into a Brooklyn family that sang in Hebrew and English.
culturalBaseline: Progressive and musical; ethics and song are her spiritual center.
